### Description

Antec's TruePower Classic series sets standards for power supplies. By using a PSU that is 80 PLUS GOLD certified, operating up to 92% efficient, you can reduce your electricity bill by up to 20% when compared to many other power supplies. TP Classic's PhaseWave design is a server-class LLC design with a synchronous rectification based on a DC-DC topology. Japanese capacitors achieve unprecedented tight voltage regulation & low ripple & noise to maximize your system's performance. Antec's intelligent thermal manager fan control spins the high-quality 12 cm DBB fan optimally to cool your PSU quietly.

## Stable power supply

- The PhaseWave design ensures a stable and reliable power supply, supporting no load operation & brown-out protection for uninterrupted performance.
- Boasting an 80 PLUS Gold certification, this power supply operates at a minimum efficiency of 92%, reducing electricity usage and operating costs.
- With specification compliance of ATX12V 2.4/ EPS12V 2.92 and a variety of power output connectors, this power supply is designed to support a wide range of PC/Server configurations.
- Features such as overcurrent, overheat, overpower, overvoltage, short-circuit, surge & inrush, thermal monitoring, and undervoltage protection safeguard your system from a wide range of potential issues.
- Equipped with a 120 mm fan, this power supply ensures efficient cooling, maintaining optimal performance even under heavy loads.
